explanation: Slope measures how steep a line is: how much y changes for each step in x. Drag the two points and watch the green run (horizontal change x2 - x1) and the violet rise (vertical change y2 - y1) update. The slope m is just rise divided by run, and a moving dot travels the line so you can see it stay constant the whole way.
bullets: Slope m = rise / run = (y2 - y1) / (x2 - x1).
The run is the horizontal change; the rise is the vertical change.
A vertical line (x1 = x2) has run 0, so its slope is undefined.
